title: skills/ios-apps and its starter name the test shape for each kind of iPhone test
why: Degen ledger D21: iPhone lanes pick test kinds by guess, so presses and gestures go untested or every test launches the app.
source: retrospective 21:38 CST Nov 12; plans/degen-report-2026-11-12.md (restart-plan 4b915b4d), row D21
note: Add a test-shape section to skills/ios-apps and its starter: pure rules in swift test; render tests at every shipped size with no app launch; one or two XCUITest smoke cases per screen for presses, gestures and navigation; taps at the drawn shape's centre through one helper; waits on state, never on time.
